Subject: Clarification Needed Regarding Visitor Arrangements

Dear [Sender's Name],

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to seek clarification on the email regarding the upcoming visitors. To ensure we provide the best possible experience for them, could you please provide more details on their specific dietary preferences? Additionally, are there any other specific arrangements or requirements we should be aware of for their stay?

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
